name: Yazdi Persian
notes: Yazdi Persian (Yazdī). Yazd — central Iranian plateau. Zoroastrian heartland; some archaic features in Zoroastrian community speech ('Dari' of Zoroastrians — not Afghan Dari). /æ/ → [a] (conservative, like Shirazi/Kermani). /q/ somewhat preserved in older/conservative speech. Already-encoded allophones confirmed against the cited sources: ā prefers the conservative [aː] over Tehran's [ɒː]; short-a prefers [a]; ق prefers the retained uvular stop [q] over the Tehran ɣ/ɢ merger (Windfuhr 2009; Rezai & al.).
